name: Multi-selection editing with mixed values
body:
# Multi-selection

With several entities selected the inspector shows the fields they share; a field whose values differ shows "--" and
typing into it sets every selected entity (one undo step). The C API gains `lantern_editor_set_field_on_selection`.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. lantern_editor_set_selection_field applies one value to every selected entity; fields differing across the selection show as mixed.
